protocol.selection: fixed-final-v1; always deploy weights after update20, earliest-best is diagnostic only

overfit.scope: bounded single training-group diagnosis only; never deployed or used for test selection

protocol.limits: Frozen V1.3 inputs/measurements, hierarchical-v3/128x4/A-B formulas/lineage/actions/all-advance continuation unchanged. No new labels or test inference. Main six models get exactly20 optimizer updates. Canonical shared-root pairs keep thresholds and absolute q intervals; changed pair membership must be reported. Known candidate-set compilation replay only, no new blind performance claim.

data_audit.note: Canonical artifact targets, pair membership, sign and gamma use the same times; old measurements untouched.

training_acceptance.scope: train/validation only; no checkpoint selected using test or replay latency

decision.trigger: A final training strong-pair direction coverage < 100%
